title: phalaris minor var. genuina
intro: Phalaris minor var. genuina, commonly known as Small Fescue or Little Fescue, is a type of grass-like plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing fever and inflammation, and treating respiratory issues such as cough and bronchitis. The health benefits of Phalaris minor var. genuina include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
